header: Bills car rentals: rent with weekly discount and season factor, extra kilometres, insurance and damage share. Tracks each rental from reservation to return or cancellation.

S1.text: Money amounts in euro cents; integer arithmetic avoids rounding drift.

Rental period between two day numbers; every rental is billed for at least one day.
Odometer readings in kilometres at pickup and at return.

S1.text: Only reserved and on-road rentals are open, i.e. still occupy a vehicle.

Any category other than van or electric is billed as a small car.

Van: 69.00 per day plus 10.00 per started 500 kg payload; 100 free km per day, then 0.40 per km.
Electric car: 50.00 per day plus 0.20 per kWh of battery; distance is never charged.
Insurance option: a premium for the period and the share of a damage the customer pays.
No premium, but the customer pays any damage in full.
9.00 per day; the customer pays damage up to the agreed deductible.
18.00 per day, billed for at most 14 days; the customer pays no damage.
